spans.s:
‘ṛgvedānukramaṇī’
by Mādhava Bhaṭṭa, son of Veṅkaṭārya; of Col. country; perhaps of 10th cent. A. D. The Kārikās comprising these indices are actually to be found distributed in the C. of the a. on the Ṛgarthadīpikā, perhaps also current independently. Title conjectural. For mss., see his Ṛgarthadīpikā under C.s on Ṛv.
Ed.. based on 6 mss.,
. by D.. C. Kunhan Raja, Mad. Uni. Skt.

‘ṛgvainavidha’
a recension of Sv. acc. to Caraṇavyūha. See above under Ṛgvarṇa.
